pages.text: $(danger)Pre-meltdown$() lasts $(num)90$() seconds.$(br2)Fix whatever caused it. If stability gets back above 35%, stress is under 90% and the structure is whole, the reactor recovers.
pages.title: Pre-meltdown

pages.text: $(num)120$() seconds. The core pulls in mobs, players and items within $(num)20$() blocks and hurts anything close.$(br2)The black hole starts taking the reactor apart, about $(thing)one block a second$(); the $(l:safety/venting_lance)lance$() holds. A stabilizer whose emitter is gone stops firing.$(br2)Only the emergency vent can save it. $(danger)Get out.$()
pages.title: Phase 1

pages.text: $(num)60$() seconds. The pull reaches $(num)32$() blocks and hits much harder. It eats the reactor and the lance as fast as the ground. Then the core $(danger)collapses$().$(br2)Blast radius: $(num)50$() blocks plus 1 per 10,000 mass, up to $(num)80$().
pages.title: Phase 2

pages.text: Server owners can turn off block damage and change every number in this book in the server config.
pages.title: Config
